title: Cartesian (×) relationship
description: Error-prone rule — relationships using the Cartesian-product (×) operator. They relate every record to every record; rarely intended and easy to leave in by accident.
author: fm-lab rules

rule.rationale: A Cartesian join matches all records and can silently return huge related sets.
rule.remediation: Confirm the × is intentional; otherwise use a keyed predicate.
